<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_DepartmentBudget" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/department-budget">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_DepartmentBudget" name="Department Budget Planning and Allocation" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_BudgetProcess" name="Department outlines objectives">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToObjectives</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DefineObjectives" name="Define department objectives for upcoming period">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToObjectives</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ObjectivesToDraft</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftPlan" name="Draft plan with cost estimates and budget justification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ObjectivesToDraft</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DraftToAlignment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AlignmentReview" name="Review plan in strategic alignment meeting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DraftToAlignment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AlignmentToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReviewMerge" name="Plan ready for finance review">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AlignmentToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ApprovalToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeToFinanceReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinanceReview" name="Perform detailed finance review of budget feasibility">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeToFinanceReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinanceReviewToDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdjustmentDecision" name="Adjustments required?" default="Flow_FinalVersionApproved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinanceReviewToDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdjustmentRequired</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinalVersionApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdjustPlan" name="Adjust plan based on review feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdjustmentRequired</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdjustToDocument</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DocumentAdjustment" name="Document adjustment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdjustToDocument</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DocumentToApproval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveAdjustment" name="Obtain stakeholder approval of adjustment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DocumentToApproval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ApprovalToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveFinal" name="Approve final budget version">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinalVersionApproved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ApprovedToAllocation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateBudget" name="Allocate and distribute budget to department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ApprovedToAllocation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AllocationToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_BudgetDistributed" name="Budget distributed and plan implementation begins">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AllocationToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToObjectives" sourceRef="Start_BudgetProcess" targetRef="Task_DefineObjectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ObjectivesToDraft" sourceRef="Task_DefineObjectives" targetRef="Task_DraftPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DraftToAlignment" sourceRef="Task_DraftPlan" targetRef="Task_AlignmentReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlignmentToMerge" sourceRef="Task_AlignmentReview" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToFinanceReview" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewMerge" targetRef="Task_FinanceReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinanceReviewToDecision" sourceRef="Task_FinanceReview" targetRef="Gateway_AdjustmentDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdjustmentRequired" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentDecision" targetRef="Task_AdjustPlan">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${adjustmentsRequired == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalVersionApproved" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentDecision" targetRef="Task_ApproveFinal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdjustToDocument" sourceRef="Task_AdjustPlan" targetRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentToApproval" sourceRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment" targetRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApprovalToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApprovedToAllocation" sourceRef="Task_ApproveFinal" targetRef="Task_AllocateBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllocationToEnd" sourceRef="Task_AllocateBudget" targetRef="End_BudgetDistributed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
